poc: At least 98% of the direct cost of making it was spent in Canada.
mic: At least 51% of the direct cost was spent in Canada, and the last major production step happened here. Sellers should add a note such as “with imported parts”.
aic: Put together in Canada, mostly from imported parts.
own: The business is majority owned by Canadians.
bic: The software was designed and developed by a team in Canada.
data: Customer data is kept on servers located in Canada.
